requirements.statement: When the inner loop exits with no build defect left, or at its cap, the verify-functional workflow runs one regression pass that re-exercises and re-judges exactly: (a) every settled-met criterion whose recorded covered files changed after its provenAt; (b) every member of each cause the inner loop fixed (awaiting regression); (c) every settled-met criterion with no covers record. Must pass.
A settled-met criterion whose covered files did not change after its provenAt is not re-exercised or re-judged by the regression pass; its verdict, artifact and provenAt stand. Must pass.

A criterion met in an early iteration whose covered file a later Debug edit changes is re-checked by the regression pass and, when that edit broke it, is ruled not met (caught) rather than left met. Must pass.

The regression pass is the proof: for every criterion it re-checked, verdict, artifact and provenAt in verification-state.json and the report are the regression pass's, and those are what custody (packages/core/lib/custody.js) reads. Must pass.
Build defects the regression pass surfaces, and only those, go back to the inner loop for one Debug round, followed by at most one more scoped regression pass. There is never a third pass. Must pass.
Evidence gaps and not-checkable results the regression pass produces are recorded with their kind and reason and are not looped on. Not marked must-pass.

The existing full-deploy gate (computeFinalRun, FULL_RUN_COMMAND) is unchanged and runs once with the exit, alongside the regression pass; 4.17.5 re-proof retry and scoped re-proof at ship are unchanged and read the regression pass's verdicts. Not marked must-pass.

The report shows the regression pass: which criteria it re-checked and why (covers changed, cause member, no covers), which it caught as broken, and that untouched met criteria were not re-walked. Must pass per acceptance.

One headless fixture run (fixtures environment in verification.md) where a fix for one cause breaks an earlier-met criterion produces a report showing the regression pass catching it while untouched met criteria are not re-walked. Must pass per acceptance.
Tests pass. Unit coverage at least 60% and integration coverage at least 50% where integration tests apply.

could_not_verify: Claim: Under --criteria (cap: 1) no Debug runs, so no regression pass can run inside a re-proof or its retry (D15). How to check: inferred from verify-build.md ~:490-512 and decideNext's cap rule; check with a harness run at cap: 1. Why not checked: needs a harness run, out of scope for a read-only audit.

Claim: A live Debug reliably reports filesChanged (TR1). How to check: the Debug agent's structured return in a live run of verify-regression-pass.sh. Why not checked: the one recorded run (.trd-state/one-full-regression-pass-at-the-end/evidence/live/REGR-T001/, 03:26) stalled before any regression pass and holds no Debug return; the reworked scenario (AMEND-003) never ran because the fixture slot could not be scaffolded in this sandbox (cp: chmod: Operation not permitted).

open_questions: OQ-1: The acceptance says custody reads provenAt from the regression pass, but custody reads status and artifact, never provenAt (custody.js ~:450-500, ~:720-733). Assumed: no custody behaviour change; a custody test pins that it reads the regression pass's entries (D15). Matters: a custody change nobody needs would be built. If wrong: a custody rule that should read provenAt is missing.

OQ-2: How are the two rounds numbered, since provenAt is an iteration number? Assumed: both keep the exit iteration's number, marked regression: 1 | 2 (D11). If wrong: readers that sort by iteration need distinct numbers.

OQ-3: When a regression Debug edits code, the gate the exit Judge ran measured the code before that edit. Assumed: the gate stays once, with the exit (O7, D12), and the report says it ran before the edits. If wrong: a deploy broken by the repair round is reported as passing the gate; the gate should re-run after a repair round (reverses convergence D14 for that case).

OQ-4: A no-covers criterion (O1c): re-checked whenever the pass runs, or only when something changed? Assumed: only when a Debug record the round is scored against has non-empty or unknown files (D5). If wrong: a no-covers criterion goes un-rechecked after a round that only had awaiting members.

OQ-5: O1(b) every member of each cause the inner loop fixed: awaiting members only, or representatives too? Assumed: awaiting members only; a representative is a settled met covered by (a) or (c). If wrong: a representative proven at the exit iteration with no later change is not re-walked, which is O2's behaviour.

OQ-6: Custody, at ship, puts every criterion in doubt when a changed file is claimed by no covers record. Should the regression pass do the same? Assumed: no; O2 forbids re-walking a criterion whose covered files did not change. Files listed in unclaimedChanges (D5, NG5). If wrong: the owner wants custody's stricter rule, which changes O2.

OQ-7: A met criterion whose regression capture fails as an evidence gap loses its met (D7, D10). Assumed: yes; O4 makes the pass's verdict the proof and O6 forbids a retry. If wrong: a failed re-capture should keep the earlier met, weakening O3.
OQ-8: The roadmap item 3 brief and the PM instruction disagree on scope. Assumed: the instruction wins (investigation header); NG1 records the brief's version.
